image_description: A dark grey, rectangular bookshelf-style loudspeaker standing on a carpeted floor against a light wall. The speaker features two visible circular drivers (cones) stacked vertically on the front baffle, with a control panel or display strip at the bottom. A black power cable extends from the rear right side.
